visual_review: Before drew a wide low box with two floating chevrons above it, reading as a face over a box; redrawn like the reference: tall rounded-top elevator frame split into two doors, an up chevron in the left door and a lower down chevron in the right door.
omissions: Chevrons span each door wall to wall (a floating chevron cannot keep 8 from both walls of a 16-wide door).
